classification: Redis product migration persistence filename incompatibility

first_failure.reason: Legacy agent selected Appendonly.aof while the current agent selects appendonly.aof; legacy logs show new empty AOF files instead of reading the retained current files

proof: The pinned source sets Appendfilename=Appendonly.aof in 0.26 and appendfilename=appendonly.aof in 0.27. The external config is included last by both agents. Legacy business diagnostics captured creation of Appendonly.aof.1.base.rdb and Appendonly.aof.1.incr.aof; current recovery loaded appendonly.aof files.
fix: Declare appendfilename=appendonly.aof in product startup configuration for both modes. Seed and WAITAOF current business before the first legacy declaration; verify acknowledged value and absolute expiry at every migration boundary.
static_regression: Exact template contract fails without the explicit filename; 67 related contracts and complete Redis static gate pass after the fix
cleanup: Original failed runner restored current product configuration, retained PVCs, removed journal and legacy Chart; subsequent read-only product health check passed
impact_analysis: The current 0.27 effective AOF filename is unchanged. The product change removes an implicit version-dependent default; runtime migration acceptance remains pending. No unrelated product or Ceph changes.

live_qualification.acceptance: Legacy fixture, retained seeded current business and absolute TTL, current recovery and owned cleanup; not full upgrade module
